scope.grid: 256 printed LP2-49–51 tokens as base-60 byte values; row order R and 32-by-8 column-major order C only.
scope.statistic: For each period p, count equal byte pairs at positions with the same residue modulo p. A residue-specific bijection preserves this count.
scope.controls: 100,000 seeded iid-uniform byte blocks; 9,024 Emerson 256-byte windows; 2,646 solved-LP1-rune windows; 10,000 seeded hexadecimal and 10,000 seeded Base64 windows.
scope.decision: Structural PASS only when observed count exceeds every uniform null; a plaintext class is EXCLUDED only when observed count is below its lower 0.1% control quantile.
scope.exclusions: No other grid route, offset, byte transform, key stream, dictionary, decompressor, or layered cipher is tested. X1, X3 and X4 are not replayed in this record.
